name: solver
description: Bevara solver: GPAC filter session with the compositor, WebCodecs, audio/video output and DASH, for <canvas>, <video> and <audio>
help: The main module that accessors (side modules) link against: pages name it in using="solver_1". It embeds the GPAC filter session and the link resolver, with the compositor, video and audio outputs, WebCodecs, the DASH segmenter and HTTP input; everything else comes from the accessors.
